title: Singapore-based data center operator DayOne files for a US IPO, reporting its H1 revenue more than tripled YoY to $512M while its net loss widened to $77.2M (Pragyan Kalita/Reuters)
summary: Pragyan Kalita / Reuters: Singapore-based data center operator DayOne files for a US IPO, reporting its H1 revenue more than tripled YoY to $512M while its net loss widened to $77.2M — Data center operator DayOne Data Centers filed for an initial public offering in the United States on Monday …
